dct_description_sm: "Deposited in the Clerk's Office for the Southern District of New York February 21, 1846."

"Deposited in the Clerk's Office for the Southern District of New York February 21, 1846." Includes notes and world map showing path of eclipse. LC copy accompanied by broadside mounted on cloth with map: Text in two columns; printed area, including ornamental border, measures 22 x 17 cm. LC copy has handwritten in top margin: Received at the State Department, April 18, 1846. 368. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
